description: A file that does not parse, so rules reading its syntax skipped it
fixGuidance: Fix the syntax error the message names. Until then the file is checked by import and path rules only, and a violation inside it cannot be reported.

description: A pure layer (models, errors, config) imported another internal layer — including another file of its own layer.
fixGuidance: models, errors and config sit at the bottom of the dependency graph. Importing upward: move the shared type down into models. Importing sideways: one model file per domain, self-contained — the ID type lives with the model that owns it. A shared.ts kernel of branded IDs is the anti-pattern, not the fix; distribute those types to their domains. An index.ts barrel is the layer's surface for consumers, and cannot resolve a file-to-file dependency inside the layer.

description: An import crossed a layer boundary in a banned direction.
fixGuidance: Dependencies point one way: components/stores/client -> routes/remote -> factory -> controllers -> services -> repositories. Import the interface, or get the value from the layer above.

description: Drizzle was imported outside the repository layer.
fixGuidance: ORM types never leave the repository layer. Query inside a repository and return a domain model.

description: @sveltejs/kit was imported by a layer that must stay framework-agnostic.
fixGuidance: Services, repositories, controllers and stores know nothing about SvelteKit. Handle framework concerns in the route or remote function.

description: $app/server or a private $env entry point was imported from a client-reachable module.
fixGuidance: Move the import into a *.server.ts, a *.remote.ts, or a module under $lib/server.

description: The generated API client was constructed outside the factory (BFF mode).
fixGuidance: Construct the client once in the factory and inject it. Import only its type elsewhere.

description: An import specifier resolved to no file in the project.
fixGuidance: Fix the path. A dangling import is invisible to every layer rule, so it hides architectural violations as well as being broken.

description: A client-reachable module imported a server-only module.
fixGuidance: Server-only code lives under $lib/server or in a *.server.ts / *.remote.ts file, and may only be imported from other server-only modules. A universal +page.ts is not server-only, even next to a +page.server.ts. Import types with `import type`.

description: A repository sits at a universal path instead of under $lib/server/.
fixGuidance: Move database repositories under $lib/server/repositories/ and browser repositories under $lib/client/repositories/. SvelteKit then makes a client import of a server repository a build error. Reported once per directory.

description: A folder under $lib/server/ does not name a layer.
fixGuidance: $lib/server/ holds db/, repositories/, services/, controllers/, factories/, infrastructure/, config.ts and the factory. An adapter for an external capability is a service, not a repository — repositories are persistence. Wiring modules may stay at the root or be grouped under factories/. Reported once per folder.

description: A src/lib/ module matches no canonical layer location.
fixGuidance: Give it a home. An ad-hoc folder gets no boundary rules of its own, so it silently opts out of the architecture it lives in.

description: Import from a layer-wide barrel rather than a domain
fixGuidance: Import the domain: $lib/models/notes, not $lib/models. A layer barrel makes every consumer depend on everything and collapses the graph into one hub. A domain's own index.ts remains the sanctioned entry point.

description: Cross-feature import reaching past a feature's entry point
fixGuidance: Import $lib/components/<feature> and export what callers need from its index.ts. Deep imports turn every internal rename into a breaking change. Within a feature, relative imports are fine.

description: A directory named misc/, common/, helpers/, pages/ or panels/
fixGuidance: Name the directory after what the code does, or move each file to the feature that owns it. A directory that describes nothing collects anything. Reported once per directory.

description: The composition root imports a concrete service or repository
fixGuidance: Depend on the interface and let a factory supply the implementation. `import type` is fine — it is erased. Once the wiring can reach for concretes, every layering rule gets an exception here.

description: The composition root constructs something other than a factory
fixGuidance: Call a factory and let it decide what to build. Assembling objects in the wiring is how it becomes the one file that knows every concrete type.

description: Placeholder wiring (undefined as unknown as T, LateValue)
fixGuidance: A placeholder means two objects need each other. Restructure so one does not — extract the shared part, or pass a typed lazy accessor. The placeholder turns a build error into a runtime one.

description: Prohibited behaviour reached through an alias, barrel, namespace import, wrapper or injected function port; or an entry point calling a service, repository or store
fixGuidance: Put the application operation in a controller and inject the narrow capability there. An entry point parses its input and calls controller operations.

description: An exported service function or callable, or a public service member outside its implemented contract
fixGuidance: Expose one cohesive class capability through its interface; keep helpers private. A test does not justify a public helper.

description: A public service class without explicit interface contracts, including alias and default exports
fixGuidance: Declare the capability callers need and `implements` it.

description: A concrete implementation used as a dependency type, including through aliases, utility types and inferred factory results
fixGuidance: Depend on the declared contract. `Pick<ConcreteService, …>` is still the concrete class, and a factory's public results need interface annotations; `satisfies` keeps the inferred concrete type.

description: A controller invoking another controller, through an interface, alias, getter or callback
fixGuidance: Coordinate the underlying services in the owning controller. Shared data types belong in models.

description: A controller calling a repository, directly or through an injected port typed as one
fixGuidance: Put a service between them. The service owns the reads and writes and the rules around them.

description: A controller result exposing a service, transport, repository or writable store
fixGuidance: Return operation results or readonly state views, never the collaborators that produced them.

description: Mutable service fields, module state or captured state that survive an operation
fixGuidance: Keep values local to the operation. State that must outlive it is a database record on the server and a store in the browser.

description: A store invoking a capability or network transport, directly or through a traced callback
fixGuidance: A store applies controlled updates. Let a controller do the work and write the result.

description: A factory executing a capability, including inside a callback it returns
fixGuidance: Construct and connect dependencies only. Execution belongs to a controller, called by an entry point.

description: An agent tool calling a service, repository or store instead of a controller operation
fixGuidance: Wrap the one public controller operation the tool stands for. When none exists, give the controller an ordinary operation any entry point could call.

description: Source or a local module the analyzer cannot inspect
fixGuidance: Repair the syntax or the module path. An incomplete scan is not a passing one.

description: An inline style attribute or style: directive in .svelte
fixGuidance: Use Tailwind utility classes defined in app.css. Styling comes from the design system, not from the element.

description: <style> block in .svelte
fixGuidance: Remove the <style> block and express the styles as Tailwind utility classes.

description: Public service class without an explicitly implemented capability interface
fixGuidance: Declare a narrow capability interface beside the service and write `implements` on the class. Controllers depend on that interface and the factory supplies the implementation. It has to be the same file — a sibling contracts.ts is a same-layer import, which the boundary rules ban.

description: hooks.server.ts sets a local other than locals.user
fixGuidance: hooks.server.ts attaches the authenticated user and nothing else. Route guards and data fetching belong in a loader.

description: Raw <button> element
fixGuidance: Use <Button, Toggle> from shadcn.

description: Raw <textarea> element
fixGuidance: Use <Textarea> from shadcn.

description: Raw <select> element
fixGuidance: Use <Select, NativeSelect, Combobox> from shadcn.

description: Raw <label> element
fixGuidance: Use <Label> from shadcn.

description: Raw <progress> element
fixGuidance: Use <Progress> from shadcn.

description: Raw <dialog> element
fixGuidance: Use <Dialog, AlertDialog, Drawer, Sheet> from shadcn.

description: Raw <nav> element
fixGuidance: Use <NavigationMenu, Breadcrumb, Menubar, Sidebar, Pagination> from shadcn.

description: Raw <kbd> element
fixGuidance: Use <Kbd> from shadcn.

description: Raw <hr> element
fixGuidance: Use <Separator> from shadcn.

description: Raw <form> element
fixGuidance: Use <Formsnap> from shadcn.

description: Raw <fieldset> element
fixGuidance: Use <Field> from shadcn.

description: Raw <table> element
fixGuidance: Use <Table, DataTable> from shadcn.

description: Raw <thead> element
fixGuidance: Use <Table, DataTable> from shadcn.

description: Raw <tbody> element
fixGuidance: Use <Table, DataTable> from shadcn.

description: Raw <tr> element
fixGuidance: Use <Table, DataTable> from shadcn.

description: Raw <th> element
fixGuidance: Use <Table, DataTable> from shadcn.

description: Raw <td> element
fixGuidance: Use <Table, DataTable> from shadcn.

description: Raw <details> element
fixGuidance: Use <Accordion, Collapsible> from shadcn.

description: Raw <summary> element
fixGuidance: Use <Accordion, Collapsible> from shadcn.

description: Raw <input> element
fixGuidance: Use <Input>, <InputOTP>, <Checkbox>, <Slider>, or <RadioGroup> from shadcn depending on the type attribute.

description: Raw used as avatar
fixGuidance: Use <Avatar> from shadcn.

description: Raw <ol> used as menu structure
fixGuidance: Use <DropdownMenu>, <ContextMenu>, or <Command> from shadcn.

description: Raw <ul> used as menu structure
fixGuidance: Use <DropdownMenu>, <ContextMenu>, or <Command> from shadcn.

description: Raw <li> used as menu structure
fixGuidance: Use <DropdownMenu>, <ContextMenu>, or <Command> from shadcn.

description: Arbitrary Tailwind colour value syntax (bg-[...], text-[#...], border-[...], etc.)
fixGuidance: Add the colour as a CSS custom property in app.css first, then reference it as a Tailwind token (e.g. bg-primary).

description: Arbitrary Tailwind typography value syntax (text-[10px], tracking-[0.4em], leading-[1.6])
fixGuidance: Define the size/leading/tracking as a CSS custom property in app.css (e.g. --text-sm) and reference it as a Tailwind token.

description: Arbitrary Tailwind spacing/sizing value syntax (w-[400px], min-h-[80vh], gap-[14px])
fixGuidance: Define the size as a CSS custom property in app.css (e.g. --space-4) and reference it as a Tailwind token.

description: Hardcoded Tailwind palette colour (text-red-500, bg-slate-800, from-blue-500)
fixGuidance: Use a semantic token from app.css (bg-background, text-muted-foreground, text-destructive). A palette class pins one appearance and cannot follow the theme, so it looks wrong in whichever mode it was not written for.

description: Dynamic class construction (class={`bg-${variable}`})
fixGuidance: Use a lookup object of pre-approved token names instead: const colourMap = { primary: 'bg-primary' }.

description: Experimental modifier class on semantic HTML
fixGuidance: Modifier classes (.glass, .neumorphic) restricted to Hero components and Overlay widgets.

description: A raw font-family utility (font-sans, font-serif, font-mono)
fixGuidance: Use the type utility that carries the family, so faces stay where the design system puts them.

description: A font weight outside 400–800
fixGuidance: Use font-normal through font-extrabold. Thin and black weights fall apart at UI sizes.

description: A font-size in em
fixGuidance: Use rem or a type-scale utility; em compounds through nesting.

description: Uppercase text without positive letter-spacing
fixGuidance: Add a tracking-wide class. Capitals set solid read as shouting and crowd each other.

description: Wide tracking on display-size text
fixGuidance: Display sizes already space themselves; keep tracking normal or tight.

description: A hex or rgb() colour literal
fixGuidance: Use a token, or oklch() in the token stylesheet. Vendored theme stylesheets are exempt.

description: A colour derived at run time (lighten, color-mix, relative colours)
fixGuidance: Define the colour as a token. A token wash toward transparent is the one allowed color-mix.

description: Pure black as a colour
fixGuidance: Use the foreground token; pure black is harsher than any surface it sits on.

description: A text token pair below WCAG AA 4.5:1, or a missing pair
fixGuidance: Adjust the token's lightness in the token stylesheet until the pair passes in both modes.

description: A heading element without a type-scale utility
fixGuidance: Add a text size or a configured heading utility; otherwise it inherits browser sizes.

description: Justified text without automatic hyphenation
fixGuidance: Add hyphens-auto, or align left. Justified text without hyphens opens rivers.

description: A text shadow with an offset or a small blur
fixGuidance: Only soft glows (no offset, blur of 8px or more) are allowed.

description: A thick coloured edge bar on a container
fixGuidance: Mark state with a wash or a hairline ring instead of a coloured side border.

description: A shadow outside the vendored primitives
fixGuidance: The surfaces are flat; use ring-1 ring-inset for a hairline edge.

description: A colour opacity step outside the sanctioned steps
Raw HTTP status code outside error handler / api route
fixGuidance: Pages/actions: throw error(status, ...) or return fail(status, ...). API routes under src/routes/api/**/+server.ts: return json(payload, { status }). Services: throw a typed domain error; HTTP status is decided only in error_handlers.

description: Test file neither colocated with its subject nor under a tests/ root
fixGuidance: Put foo.spec.ts beside foo.ts, or move it under tests/unit/, tests/integration/ or tests/e2e/ so its kind is visible from its path.

description: Test name does not describe an invariant
fixGuidance: Name the test after the invariant it proves: test_cannot_X, test_returns_Y_when_Z. When it fails, the name alone should say what broke.

description: A test that asserts nothing
fixGuidance: Assert the outcome of the behaviour the test names, in the test body. One test covers one behaviour and may assert all of its outcomes; do not split outcomes just to count assertions, and do not hide them in helpers. End-to-end specs are exempt.

description: Mocking library usage (vi.mock, jest.fn, spyOn, sinon)
fixGuidance: Write a fake that implements the full interface. In a layered architecture with injected dependencies you can always construct the real object; needing a mock is a signal the wiring is wrong.

description: test.skip without an explanation
fixGuidance: Pass a reason string, or put one in a comment above the skip: what blocks it and when it comes back. A bare skip is debt nobody can see.

description: A Fake*/Stub*/InMemory* class declared in a spec with no interface
fixGuidance: Add `implements <Interface>`, or move the double to the shared testing folder where production parameters type it. Without either, the fake drifts from the real contract silently.

description: An object or array literal cast through `unknown` in a test
fixGuidance: The cast silences the error that says the fixture is incomplete, so the test runs on a state production cannot produce. Build a complete value, or narrow the type the code under test depends on. Casting one value (a branded id, a corrupt input for a parser) is not reported.

description: Assertion on calls (toHaveBeenCalled and friends)
fixGuidance: Assert on output or resulting state. Interaction assertions pin the internals, so a behaviour-preserving refactor breaks the test for no reason.

description: npm or yarn lockfile found instead of pnpm
fixGuidance: Use pnpm exclusively for the frontend.

description: Backend infrastructure variables in frontend .env
fixGuidance: Keep frontend/.env and backend/.env separate. Never share secrets.

description: Service has no test file
fixGuidance: Add a test file under tests/unit/ covering its core invariants.

description: A test-runner include pattern matches no files
fixGuidance: Fix the pattern or delete it. A glob matching nothing means part of the suite stopped running and CI stayed green — the one failure mode the test suite cannot report itself.

description: Maintained documentation cites a path that does not exist
fixGuidance: Update the reference or remove it. Checked in root and docs/ markdown; generated API references and build output are excluded. A path the repository gitignores is a file the project creates at run time, such as a cached login, so it is allowed to be absent.

description: A catch or rejection handler that neither rethrows nor returns a failure result
fixGuidance: Rethrow, or return an object whose `kind` is 'error', 'failure' or 'corrupt' (or `ok: false`) so the caller decides. Add a log or toast as well where someone needs to know; it never counts as the recovery. Suppress only where the recovery reports itself somewhere the type cannot show, and name where.

description: A type assertion onto an object literal
fixGuidance: Construct the value with its real type, or parse it. `value as never` on one branded value is fine; `{ … } as T` hides every missing field.

description: A cast onto an inline object type (`x as { a?: unknown }`)
fixGuidance: Parse the value into a named type at the boundary instead of probing its fields.

description: A JSON.parse result given a type nothing checked
fixGuidance: Annotate it `unknown` and parse it with a schema that produces the type.

description: A response JSON result cast without parsing
fixGuidance: Parse `await response.json()` with the schema of the type it should be.

description: `Record<string, unknown>` or an `unknown` index signature used as a struct
fixGuidance: Name the fields the code reads, or parse into a type that does.

description: A type predicate that narrows to an open-keyed record
fixGuidance: Parse into the concrete type. A guard to `Record<string, unknown>` leaves every caller probing.

description: A z.unknown() or z.any() schema
fixGuidance: Describe the shape. A schema that accepts anything narrows nothing.

description: `unknown` on a parameter, return, field or alias in a model, service or controller
fixGuidance: Parse at the boundary — remote functions, routes, repositories, the service that owns a provider, browser services — so the layers inward receive narrow types.

description: A model function that computes instead of constructing data or a schema
fixGuidance: Move the calculation to a service. Models hold values, types, schemas and constructors; a branded-scalar constructor may validate its input.

description: A class or mutable module state in a model
fixGuidance: Models are data. Runtime state belongs in a store, behaviour in a service.

description: instanceof in a model
fixGuidance: Discriminate with a tagged union; models carry no classes to test against.

description: An agent tool or protocol server constructed outside the declared tool adapters
fixGuidance: Build tools through the adapter listed in `agent.toolAdapters`, which applies the shared approval and feedback policy.

description: An icon library imported instead of the project's own icon set
fixGuidance: Import the icon from the module named in `designSystem.icons`. Component generators write library imports into what they add; replace them.

description: An API route serves the app's own UI instead of a remote function.
fixGuidance: Move it to a remote function in $lib/remote/*.remote.ts, or to a loader / form action if the data belongs to a page. Routes that are genuinely HTTP — OAuth callbacks, webhooks, SSE streams, file downloads, protocol endpoints — are detected and exempt.

description: A chisel-ignore comment gave no reason, so it suppressed nothing.
fixGuidance: Write `chisel-ignore <rule-id> -- <why this case is different>`. A suppression nobody has to justify is one nobody will revisit.

description: A chisel-ignore comment that suppresses no violation.
fixGuidance: Delete it. The code it excused has changed; left in place, it hides the next violation written on that line.

description: A chisel-ignore comment naming a rule chisel does not have.
fixGuidance: Correct the id — `chisel-js rules` lists them — or delete the comment.

description: A client chunk containing application code exceeds the size budget
fixGuidance: Split the route or import the heavy part dynamically. Vendor-only chunks are tolerated as a known cost; a chunk mixing application code is a regression. Requires a production build — run `chisel-js bundle` after building.
